youSaidWeDid.said: Bathrooms scored lowest: drains backing up and a peeling tub.
Requests for updated kitchen appliances (microwave, dishwasher).
A garage door wasn't rolling smoothly; bathroom vanity and medicine cabinet showing wear.
Safety: broken common-area walkway lighting and an aging carbon-monoxide alarm.
More foot traffic in a back alley; a request for security cameras.
Laundry and appliance issues: a slow dryer, a mildew-prone washer, a sticky stove burner.
